backend: offline committed resources only; no network, no GPU
distinct_from: SLM-306 (docs/design/slm306-locked-manifest-digest-verification.md) built the verify_locked_manifest_digest/load_locked_manifest_payload primitive and threaded locked_manifest_path through validate_result_claim with a None default everywhere. SLM-430 (docs/design/slm430-promotion-cli-locked-manifest-digest-opt-in.md) wired an explicit, default-off opt-in into the three real training/CLI promotion entrypoints (train(), scripts/resume_climb.py, scripts/run_scaling_ladder.py), explicitly scoping itself to those three and leaving src/slm_training/web/routes.py untouched. SLM-431 closes that fourth reachable caller of validate_result_claim -- the pure-compute POST /api/promotion/evaluate endpoint that powers the live Checkpoints dashboard gate editor -- with the same additive, default-off posture.

canonical_manifest.note: recomputed via load_locked_manifest_payload(canonical_manifest_path()); matches the digest SLM-306 and SLM-430 both recorded, confirming the committed manifest is still untampered

reproduction.method: each test drives POST /api/promotion/evaluate through fastapi.testclient.TestClient with a minimal preregistered ExperimentCampaignV1 manifest and a self-consistent CampaignResultV1, checking for the presence/absence of locked_eval_manifest_digest_unverified_on_disk in checks.campaign_governance.failures

honesty.scope: governance/gate HTTP-endpoint-wiring audit only -- no model quality, promotion, or training result is claimed here
honesty.backward_compatibility: verify_locked_manifest_digest defaults to False everywhere; every existing caller of POST /api/promotion/evaluate (including the live Checkpoints dashboard gate editor) that never set it keeps its prior (self-consistency-only) behavior unchanged.
honesty.still_open: Flipping the default to always supply canonical_manifest_path() (rather than requiring the flag) remains open, exactly as SLM-306 and SLM-430 both scoped it, pending a live end-to-end promotion run to validate against -- not available in this GPU-less sandbox.
